snippet.title: Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga - Opening Movie
snippet.description:
The opening cinematic sets the stage for an unforgettable adventure!

Legends unite as characters from the Ys and Trails series come together in a historic crossover RPG!
Join Adol Christin, Estelle Bright, and other beloved heroes as they embark on a journey to restore the lost land of Xanadu and face the looming threat of the Dragon King!

Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/ys-vs-trails-in-the-sky-alternative-saga-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010925
